metadata.title: ORCHID ESPEI datasets from the literature
metadata.description:
ORCHID ESPEI datasets from the literature: ESPEI 0.9.1 datasets built from the ORCHID literature values and from DFT, one folder per evidence class: experimental/ (thermochemical and phase-composition ZPF tables), invariants/ (ZPF from invariant-reaction tables), model/ (values the papers calculated with a CALPHAD model, TDB SHA-256), dft/literature, dft/mp, dft/oqmd (HM_FORM of TDB phase endmembers, mapped through the ORCHID phase registry). Every literature value carries its ORCHID observation id and source DOI and passes the inclusion rules of the published literature values; every value carries its uncertainty in physical units (printed; ESPEI's experimental default where none was printed; DFT sigma calibrated against experiment, leave-system-out) and the ESPEI weight derived from it. Optional phase constraints, tagged and kept in their own folders (never mixed with measured data): derived/invariant-brackets/ (phase sets just above and below each printed invariant temperature), derived/liquid-stability/ (single-phase liquid above the highest liquidus where the sources show complete liquid miscibility) and assessed/ (assessed handbook phase-field points in each assessment's phase names). Encoding fixes (vacancy components, line-compound vertices, duplicate invariants and rows, audited activity reference states, optional minimum-sigma weights) are counted in VALIDATION.md; literature records to correct are listed in UPSTREAM_CORRECTIONS.md. Validated with ESPEI 0.9.1 check_dataset and load_datasets (VALIDATION.md). Part of the ORCHID data release v2026.10.

Limitations

  • Version 1, machine-extracted literature values.
  • Model-calculated values have no measurement uncertainty: choose your own weight.
  • 0 K DFT energies are used as 298.15 K enthalpies; DFT residuals are heavy-tailed.
  • Use one DFT source per fit (different elemental references).
  • Derived phase constraints encode the semantics of printed reactions; they are not measurements.

Licence

ORCHID's data are released under CC BY 4.0, as are the SGTE (B. Hallstedt, Calphad 89 (2025) 102833), Materials Project and OQMD data from which they are derived; attributions and statements of changes are in NOTICE.md, the licence of each folder in LICENSES.md (both in the bundle). The quotations from papers that accompany values are short excerpts kept for verification; they remain under the publishers' copyright and are not relicensed. Source papers, page images and full texts are not redistributed.
